main_body: deciduous tree with rounded foliage canopy and straight trunk
top_band: light and mid green top crown clusters across rows 1-14 above darker lower foliage
evidence: The tree shows a rounded 3D foliage volume lit from above/top-left (rows 1-24) with a shaded underside (rows 25-30) overhanging the vertical trunk (rows 30-46). However, the trunk base is drawn with a completely flat horizontal bottom line at row 45-46 rather than natural spreading roots in 3/4 view, though the overall volume reads as 3/4.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference trees, the candidate looks stiff, geometric, and simplified. The trunk is a straight vertical column (rows 30-42) with large vertical bands of flat brown colour and a ruler-flat horizontal base line, lacking the organic gnarled bark texture and spreading 3D roots of the references. The canopy is a single smooth lollipop ball with noisy pillow-like shading rather than distinct, crisp leaf clusters and visible interior branches.
